candidats.description: Sawn timber stacked beside a railway line and on a bogie in a timber yard. A chimney stack and buildings can be seen in the distance. Photographed by William Archer Price, at an unidentified location, ca 1920s. An unidentified group of saw mill workers are standing on the stacked sawn planks. Quantity: 1 b&w original negative(s). Physical Description: Dry plate glass negative 4.75 x 6.5 inches Timber stacked in sawmill yard. Price, William Archer, 1866-1948 :Collection of post card negatives. Ref: 1/2-001251-G. Alexander Turnbull Library, Wellington, New Zealand. natlib.govt.nz/records/2315313
